integrity: The proof is finite and exact: a graph reconstruction, all-pairs distances, complete clique enumeration, four elementary collapses, and a fully replayed acyclic discrete-Morse matching. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the shortest-path metric on the 12-vertex truncated tetrahedral graph, not the Euclidean chordal metric of a geometric embedding, and it treats only this single Archimedean solid. The literature search cannot certify absolute global novelty.
title: The graph-metric Rips filtration of the truncated tetrahedron
